prompt: Conservation work on Lord Limerick’s Follies at Tollymore Park, Newcastle, Co. Down, began in May 2010, in memory of which conservation architect who died in 2008?
answer: The conservation work was carried out in memory of **Dick Oram**, the conservation architect and founder trustee of the Follies Trust.
